features.name: Idiomatic Go Restructure
features.description: Refactor the monolithic server-go/main.go (1721 lines) into the idiomatic Go layout from OPIK_ALIGNMENT.md §5: cmd/server/main.go, internal/{config,database,model,repository,service,api,worker}. Constructor injection, interfaces, no globals. This is the foundation for everything else.
features.evidence: server-go/cmd/server/main.go + internal/{config,logging,database,model,queue,worker,api}. Handlers are Server methods; no package-level db/dbMu/logger. go build ./... and go test ./... green.

features.name: Typed Errors & Error Middleware
features.description: Define api.Error{Code,Message,Status,Err}. Every handler returns it, one middleware renders JSON and logs the cause with request ID. Never render err.Error() of a driver error to a client. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D7)

features.name: Validated Config Struct
features.description: internal/config with typed struct, defaults, Validate(). All ~20 os.Getenv calls become fields loaded once at boot. Fail fast on bad values. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D8)
features.evidence: internal/config/config.go: typed Config, Load(), Validate(), AuthRequired(), Issuer(). Bad AUTH_MODE/LOG_LEVEL/URL fails startup.

features.name: Embedded SQL Migrations
features.description: Replace CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blob with numbered migrations in internal/database/migrations/ using embed.FS. Track in schema_migrations table. Forward-only. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D10)
features.evidence: internal/database/{db,migrate,legacy}.go + embedded migrations/control/{0001_init,0002_product,0003_thread_jobs}.sql and telemetry/{0001_init,0002_threads}.sql; schema_migrations tracked per plane, each migration transactional, legacy adoption/import preserved.

features.name: Repository Interfaces (MetadataStore + TelemetryStore)
features.description: Define TelemetryStore and MetadataStore interfaces per OPIK_ALIGNMENT D1. PostgreSQL implementations in internal/repository/postgres/ and DuckDB implementations in internal/repository/duckdb/. The physical split already exists (PostgreSQL control plane + DuckDB telemetry), but handlers still issue SQL directly; extracting interfaces is what makes a ClickHouse migration possible without rewriting them.

features.name: Dataset Versioning (Immutable Snapshots)
features.description: Implement dataset_versions table with content hash, full item snapshot, delta counts. Experiments pin dataset_version_id at creation. Worker reads the snapshot, not the live table. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D3)
features.evidence: dataset_versions stores full items_json + SHA-256 hash + delta counts; handlers snapshot inside the write transaction; experiments pin dataset_version_id; worker reads /dataset_versions/{id}. Verified by Go tests and smoke (version=3).

features.name: Prompt Versioning & Eval Integration
features.description: Prompts become append-only prompt_versions with commit hash. POST /evaluations accepts prompt:{name, version}. The resolved template is passed to the worker and recorded on the experiment. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D4)
features.evidence: Experiments resolve and store prompt_version_id; POST /evaluations accepts prompt_name+prompt_version or prompt_version_id; worker fetches /prompts/{id} and renders the template. UI prompt selector + pinned rerun.

features.name: Feedback Definitions (Scorer Registry in DB)
features.description: Move scorer registry from Go literals to the database. Seed builtins on first boot, expose POST /feedback-definitions for custom numerical/categorical scorers. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D5)

features.name: Go httptest Test Suite
features.description: Table-driven httptest tests for every handler group, each against a private PostgreSQL schema and a temporary DuckDB file. Assert status codes, error bodies, one end-to-end path per resource. At least 80% route coverage. (OPIK_ALIGNMENT D11)
features.evidence: internal/api has httptest suites for auth/OAuth/MCP (44 path), OTLP protobuf+JSON, dataset snapshots, prompt pinning, token provenance, scoped access. Full route-coverage target not yet measured.

features.name: Smoke & Regression Test Pass
features.description: All existing test suites pass after restructure: smoke_api.py (41), auth_test.py (44), mcp_test.py (23), fault_test.py (16). This gates every merge.
features.evidence: Go tests green (incl. threads_test.go); smoke 41/41; auth 44/44; MCP 23/23; fault 16/16 (crash/restart, timeout, retry); load 360 traces, 0 errors.

features.name: Conversations + Control/Data Plane Split
features.description: Make conversations (threads) first-class: thread_id on ingest, open/closed lifecycle with idle sweep, thread-level scores and evaluators, conversation UI and dashboard metrics. Split storage into control.db (metadata/datasets/experiments/prompts/jobs/auth) and telemetry.db (spans/feedback/eval_runs/threads/thread_scores) with one-time legacy adoption and per-plane retention.
features.evidence: server-go/internal/api/threads.go + threads_test.go; dual-plane database/{db,legacy,migrate}.go; control+telemetry migrations; thread job kind and worker thread callback; five thread scorers; Conversations/ThreadDetail pages; dashboard conversation metrics. Verified: go test ./... green, smoke 41/41, auth 44/44, MCP 23/23, fault 16/16, load 360/360 traces, browser checks on conversation list/detail/trace filter/evaluate.

features.name: PostgreSQL Control Plane + DuckDB Telemetry
features.description: Move the control plane from SQLite to PostgreSQL and the telemetry plane from SQLite to DuckDB, keeping the plane boundary and merging results in Go. Transport existing SQLite data once, without losing rows.
features.evidence: server-go/internal/database/{db,import,migrate,legacy}.go + internal/pgbind; migrations per plane; imported 245 spans, 28 feedback, 25 eval runs, 56 threads, 28 thread scores and all control rows into the new engines; go test ./... green; smoke 41/41; auth 44/44; MCP 23/23; fault 16/16; load 360/360 traces.
